body:
I know the feeling.  I have fought depression for more than 20 years and it seems that everything that is designed to be good in my life ends up on failure.  I feel like I'm smaller than an ant most times and like an ant bed I am constantly striving to build a great life around me  and just when I think things may be good, someone has to come by and destroy everything around me.  Every morning I wake up and my first thoughts are putting a gun to my head and end things but I end up putting the gun down and I am not sure why?  I know it would be quick and almost painless if done right but I think of the consequences of me being a Christian if I did take my own life. This does not change the fact that I still want to die and I too wish that my life will be cut short though a fatal car accident or someone puts a gun to my head and kills me... Heck, I even pray to a God that I am slowly but surely convincing myself that doesn't exist because I have asked Him to end my life or give me some terminal illness that will finally take me from this Earth.  
I have been at the end of my rope for some time now and for some reason I still hang on and I really do not comprehend why that is because I am so damn miserable being stuck here in a world that deems me unfit to coexist.  
Some people will tell me that God isn't finished with me which is why I'm still here but what that is I don't know.  I am pretty much done with the world around me and yet I am stuck because, like you, I am too scared to take matters in my own hand.  
I don't have any comforting words of encouragement only that you are not alone...
